title: Food Chains and Food Webs
summary: Who eats whom in the Western Ghats, and why removing one species can cause a chain reaction.

ib.note: Trophic levels and keystone species follow in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: How Nature Works in Harmony

objectives: I can construct food chains and interpret food webs.
I can predict the effects of removing a species from a food web.
I can explain why food webs are more stable than single food chains.
misconceptions: Arrows in a food chain show who eats whom (they show the direction energy flows).
Removing a predator only affects its prey.
Each animal eats only one kind of food.
